bugs.error_message: M272 initial full CTest failed in whole-system mass audit with residual=0.057020 m3 after SWMM API-lateral bridge wiring.
bugs.root_cause: The concrete SWMM provider's raw external-net observation was passed to the audit without removing the API lateral component already represented by CouplingLib surface exchange.
bugs.fix: Added a deduplicated SWMM audit observation that removes the API lateral component exactly once.

bugs.error_message: M272 first bridge build failed because routingStep was not available in addExternalInflows(DateTime).
bugs.root_cause: The bridge initially attempted to accumulate API lateral volume at the inflow call site, although routing-total integration already supplies the interval.
bugs.fix: Kept API lateral as a step flow component integrated by massbal_updateRoutingTotals.

bugs.error_message: G26 declared ci_gate:false but CTest labeled test_swmm_external_net as golden.
bugs.root_cause: The manifest checker did not reject the golden label on non-gating entries.
bugs.fix: Changed G26 to candidate_non_gating and added the matching manifest invariant.

bugs.error_message: SimDriver baseline sampled raw SWMM external net while epoch samples subtracted API lateral using a second observation.
bugs.root_cause: API lateral deduplication was split across two hooks and only applied to current epoch samples.
bugs.fix: SwmmEngine now exposes one deduplicated audit observation used for baseline and epoch samples.

bugs.error_message: MSBUILD error MSB1009: test_goldensuite_manifest.vcxproj does not exist.
bugs.root_cause: test_goldensuite_manifest is a CTest registration, not a build target.
bugs.fix: Build executable targets and invoke the manifest check through ctest.

bugs.error_message: dflowfm_spike_host.exe: error while loading shared libraries: dflowfm.dll: cannot open shared object file
bugs.root_cause: Git Bash did not pass the prefixed POSIX PATH to the Windows loader.
bugs.fix: Run the spike through cmd.exe with the D-Flow release bin prepended to Windows PATH.

bugs.error_message: Standalone M273 spike build failed with LNK1181 because install_fm-suite_release/lib/dflowfm.lib does not exist.
bugs.root_cause: The release install provides the DLL while the import library is at the Delft3D source root.
bugs.fix: Configure with H:/githubcode/SCAU-UFM/Delft3D-main/lib/dflowfm.lib.

bugs.error_message: M273 completion review agent could not run because the API reported insufficient credits (402).
bugs.root_cause: The subagent credit budget was exhausted.
bugs.fix: Completed spike-only scope and reproducibility checks inline.

bugs.error_message: gh pr update-branch 70 failed because M272 and M273 both added OpenWolf/index files.
bugs.root_cause: Parallel M272/M273 branches had add/add conflicts in generated context files and overlapping INDEX/memory additions.
bugs.fix: Merged latest master in a clean sync worktree and semantically combined M272 and M273 records.

bugs.error_message: Initial M274 ifx invocation mangled /c, /O2 and /I through MSYS path conversion and could not open m_flow.mod.
bugs.root_cause: Git Bash rewrote native Intel compiler switches as POSIX paths.
bugs.fix: Set MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*' and use /I:<path>; the bridge object then compiled successfully.

bugs.error_message: Clean external D-Flow configure stopped because Conan was not installed and the required delft3d_windows_msvc_194_v2 profile was absent.
bugs.root_cause: The local D-Flow source snapshot used the new Conan 2 build flow, but this machine only retained older build artifacts and no current Conan user configuration.
bugs.fix: Installed Conan 2.31.2 and ran run_conan.py initialize external to install governed profiles/settings without Deltares Nexus remotes.

bugs.error_message: Governed D-Flow source build reached PETSc but failed because conanbuild.sh sourced a generated conanbuildenv script with Windows backslash paths under Cygwin bash.
bugs.root_cause: The current Windows+Cygwin Conan generator/recipe combination emits `script_folder` with raw `C:\...` backslash paths in `conanbuildenv-release-x86_64.sh`, which PETSc's Cygwin shell cannot consume reproducibly.
bugs.fix: Changed the local PETSc recipe to avoid Conan's broken win_bash environment scripts, invoke configured Cygwin bash explicitly, derive shell paths through that installation's cygpath.exe, prioritize Cygwin Python, and regenerate conan.lock before the governed build. PETSc now enters its real configure/build stage.

bugs.error_message: PETSc package() failed with 'make: command not found' under explicit Cygwin bash, and later expat/2.8.0 failed with C1020 unexpected #endif in random_rand_s.c line 47.
bugs.root_cause: Two independent residues after the shell-path fix: (1) the package() stage runs in a fresh process whose entry PATH lacked Cygwin /usr/bin, unlike the build stage; (2) under codepage 936 MSVC decodes expat's UTF-8 curly quotes in a comment as GBK, swallowing the newline so the following '#if defined(__MINGW32__)' merges into the comment and the '#endif' becomes unmatched.
bugs.fix: Appended C:\cygwin64\bin to the governed build entry PATH (after native Python/oneAPI so PowerShell still resolves Windows python.exe), and added tools.build:cflags/cxxflags=["/utf-8"] to the delft3d_windows_msvc_194_v2 profile (repo copy and installed CONAN_HOME copy). PETSc 3.25.3 binary 31ee0027 is now packaged in the Conan cache.

bugs.error_message: M274 native water-balance probe could initialize and run the rebuilt D-Flow DLL but dflowfm_get_water_balance_v1 was missing from the Windows export table.
bugs.root_cause: The bind(C) bridge function had no Intel Fortran DLLEXPORT directive, while the upstream D-Flow DLL API uses explicit !DEC$ ATTRIBUTES DLLEXPORT declarations for Windows exports.
bugs.fix: Added !DEC$ ATTRIBUTES DLLEXPORT :: dflowfm_get_water_balance_v1 to the bridge function before rebuilding the dflowfm_dll target.

bugs.error_message: M274 lateral matrix case could not start because spikes/dflowfm/cases/single_reach_lateral/Flow1D.mdu was absent in the local checkout.
bugs.root_cause: The local runtime asset directory for the authored lateral case was not present, so the probe host failed before model initialization.
bugs.fix: Use the existing single_reach_1d case with its verified lat1 lateral registration for the lateral probe instead of relying on the missing directory.

bugs.error_message: G27 leg1 failed: sum(vol1)=6500 != native vol1tot=5500 at initialize on the open-boundary case; storage delta over 10 steps disagreed with boundary flux by 3.14 m3
bugs.root_cause: BMI vol1 array stores internal cells first, then boundary ghost nodes (ndxi..ndx). M258/M259 confirmed sum(vol1)==storage on a CLOSED case only; on open-boundary models the full sum overcounts physical storage by the ghost volumes, whose dynamics also pollute deltas.
bugs.fix: Added DFlowFMEngine::internal_cell_count() (BMI scalar ndxi, fail-closed) and observe_dflowfm_internal_volume (sums vol1[0:ndxi]); RunLoopHooks.dflowfm_storage_volume override binds native vol1tot in real mode; G27 locks the discovery with an explicit full>internal+100 assertion on the open case and full==internal on the closed case.

bugs.error_message: G19 scope-complete audit residual +37.79 m3/epoch with drive_outfall_stage=true
bugs.root_cause: Writing river stage onto a SWMM outfall makes the engine fill from its boundary (reverse flow) with NO routing-totals class and NO CouplingLib debit from D-Flow: system-level mass creation bypassing the ledger invariant.
bugs.fix: G19 fixture stops driving outfall stage; governed reverse exchange planned as M278; whole-system audit stays armed and fails closed on any reverse-import config.

bugs.error_message: Standalone SWMM probe: constant API lateral into dry pipes delivers +0.067 m3 more than q*dt (constant beyond 60s), massbal records only q*dt
bugs.root_cause: SWMM dynamic/kinematic wetting front on initially dry conduits creates geometric volume not backed by recorded inflow (engine-internal startup continuity error; routing-step and MIN_SURFAREA independent).
bugs.fix: G19 fixture starts wet (conduit InitFlow=0.005) removing the artifact; residual recession error (-0.03 m3 scale) measured and bounded as documented engine gap (0.05 m3) in the M277 audit decomposition.

bugs.error_message: G19 epoch-2 residual -0.030: driver injected 0.6207 m3 into river while SWMM emitted only 0.5243 m3 through the outfall
bugs.root_cause: 1D-1D interface q_request samples the instantaneous outfall rate pre-step and injects it for the whole dt_sub; during recession the sample overestimates and the seam creates the difference (not volume conservative).
bugs.fix: Interface leg excluded from the G19 conservation fixture (G17 keeps behavioral coverage); emitted-volume ledger-backed injection designed as M278; audit armed against re-enablement.

bugs.error_message: Env-less ctest of G19 hung indefinitely after a gateway run (and after manually deleting the app-local netcdf.dll)
bugs.root_cause: The gateway overwrites the vcpkg-deployed app-local netcdf.dll with the D-Flow runtime's copy, whose dependencies only resolve with the runtime bin on PATH; a plain ctest run then blocks forever on a Windows loader error dialog. Deleting the DLL entirely hangs the same way (missing import).
bugs.fix: Gateway now restores the vcpkg netcdf.dll beside the G19 exe after the real run (best-effort); never delete an app-local vcpkg DLL, and check for loader dialogs when a test that should GTEST_SKIP hangs.
